protocol.hypothesis: A long stored claim can hide its final recommendation beyond the encoder character limit. Derive at most one additional bounded conclusion vector without altering primary vectors or claims; append matches only into unused hybrid result slots, preserving all incumbent ranks and full pools.

trials.tail_admission: normal minimum (0.3), without the short-query relaxation
max(normal minimum, 0.4) for the separate conclusion view if strict admission fails guards

design: Only providers declaring a positive character limit produce overflow views. Short records keep precisely their existing representation.
Use the last nonempty paragraph of the stored title/content text, bounded to the final encoder-window characters. At most two vectors per long record total.
Derived conclusion vectors bind memory ID, model and current claim hash; old vectors remain valid and get conclusion backfill without requiring a new model release.
Apply repository, state, tags and caller visibility before conclusion limits. Reject late writes after edit/delete/clear/cancellation.
Keep original claims and packet budget; actual full-claim delivery must improve, not merely candidates.

Final selected representation requires a blank-line-separated paragraph beginning outside the primary encoder window. CRLF is normalized only for the conclusion view; trailing whitespace alone cannot create overflow.
protocol.selection: Select the first development improvement preserving per-fact delivery/ranks and negative IDs/order across all old and new cases. Score only a safe selected candidate on the exposed reserved split. If neither passes restore runtime and report rejected trials; do not tune on reserved outputs.
protocol.limitations: New cases reuse historical source incidents and explicit synthetic prefaces. No new independent semantic or end-to-end agent success claim. Full-pool misses remain protected and unresolved.

amendments.trigger: The initial development-safe prototype failed the unchanged supplementary_diagnostics_require_a_truncated_character_window_a_failure_and_a_free_slot test: a suffix of a one-paragraph claim gained relevance that its original contextual vector did not have.
amendments.decision: Reject arbitrary one-paragraph suffixes. Index only an explicitly separated final paragraph starting beyond the declared primary window. Preserve the original test unchanged. This narrows representation to previously invisible complete context.
amendments.timing: Amendment follows the legacy contract failure, not reserved-split outcome selection. Initial reserved evaluation had already been launched concurrently with the crate suite; it is preliminary exposed evidence, not blind validation.

protocol.registration_serialization: JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) plus a final newline

decision: Ship explicit hidden-conclusion indexing at the unchanged normal admission threshold. Initial arbitrary-suffix prototype rejected by an existing unit contract; conservative-threshold alternative not needed.

guards.timing_note: Replays overlapped compilation and frontend tests; not a latency benchmark.

preliminary_prototype.rejection: Unchanged legacy diagnostic guard failed: expected one result, arbitrary claim suffix added a second. Explicit hidden paragraphs remove this unsupported context-free representation.
preliminary_prototype.selection_caveat: Reserved outputs were exposed concurrently with the failing crate suite; the amendment was driven by that legacy unit contract. All incidents were already exposed. No blind selection claim.
